LanguageData.Gun_Sten_Mk_I_RWP.label: Sten Mk I
LanguageData.Gun_Sten_Mk_I_RWP.description: A simple and rugged submachine gun, the Sten Mk I is known for its ease of manufacture and reliability in battle. Fires 9x19mm rounds in a spray, effective at close to mid-range. Deals moderate damage with a high rate of fire, ideal for overwhelming enemies quickly. Widely used for its practicality and straightforward design.
